subject: HealthNet: SOC 2 Type II + control evidence and bridge letter
messages:
From: Emily Zhou <e.zhou@healthnet.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report + additional control evidence request

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well — HealthNet is in the middle of a vendor security review for an upcoming integration and we need a copy of Redwood’s most recent SOC 2 Type II report (audit period covering 2025). Beyond the report, our auditors require a small set of control artifacts related to authentication and access management to validate MFA, logging, and privileged access review practices. Specifically: 

- A copy of the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF).
- MFA policy and a config snapshot showing enforcement (conditional/2FA) for console/API access.
- A sample of auth logs (redacted user IDs okay) covering a 2-week slice in May 2026 showing successful/failed MFA events and service account behavior.
- Evidence of at least one privileged access review in the last 12 months (review artifacts or minutes).
- Any bridge letter you can provide if the SOC 2 coverage window ends before Jul 2026 (we may need a short statement covering the gap).

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We can accept files via your secure download link or an SCP share — whatever is easiest. Marcus Lee (procurement) is cc’d to track timelines.

Thanks,
Emily Zhou
Senior InfoSec Manager
HealthNet Partners

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <e.zhou@healthnet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + additional control evidence request

Emily — thanks for the detail. I’ve looped in Laura (security compliance) and Monica (customer success) to assemble the artifacts. Quicknotes:

- We can share the SOC 2 Type II report right away.
- MFA policy and enforcement snapshots are available; Laura will confirm exactly what we can export without exposing internal PII.
- For auth logs, we typically provide sampled CSV slices with user identifiers redacted; we’ll aim for the two-week window in May 2026 you requested.
- Privileged access review artifacts exist (Q1 2026) — we’ll include a redacted copy of the reviewer notes and attestation.
- We can draft a bridge letter for any audit window gap; Laura will prepare a short draft for your legal/audit review.

ETA: I’ll push to have a secure package ready by Friday (2026-07-16). If you need anything sooner for procurement, let me know.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + additional control evidence request

Adding a quick compliance checklist and constraints for the package: 

1) SOC 2 report — full PDF (we include the auditor’s opinion). Ready.

2) MFA — we can provide the MFA policy PDF and an export of the identity provider (IdP) enforcement rules showing which groups/patterns have 2FA required. We cannot export full user credential artifacts; instead we’ll provide a snapshots.csv that enumerates enforcement flags by role/group.

3) Auth logs — we can provide a redacted CSV (auth_log_sample_202605.csv) covering 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-24. We’ll strip PII and replace usernames with hashed ids; we’ll include a README explaining redaction. The sample will include timestamp, event_type (login_success/login_failure/mfa_challenge/mfa_success), source_ip (first three octets only), and service_account boolean.

4) Privileged access review — we’ll attach a redacted PDF of the Q1 2026 privileged access review (access_review_2026Q1.pdf) and the reviewer attestation page.

5) Bridge letter — I’ve drafted a short bridge letter (bridge_letter_draft.pdf) that covers the gap between the end of the SOC 2 period and today; it references our continuing controls and is intentionally succinct for auditor consumption.

I’ll place all files in a secure bundle and provide a pre-signed download link and an HMAC token for retrieval. Monica — can you validate the timeline with the procurement team and advise if they need a DocuSign/NDA before we share?

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <e.zhou@healthnet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lee <m.lee@healthnet.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + additional control evidence request

Emily — thanks for your patience. Per Laura’s note we assembled the package and uploaded it to a secure store. Contents (redacted where appropriate):

- SOC2_Report_2025_TypeII.pdf (full auditor report)
- MFA_Policy_and_Config.pdf (policy + IdP enforcement snapshot)
- auth_log_sample_202605.csv (redacted 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-24 slice)
- access_review_2026Q1.pdf (redacted reviewer minutes & attestation)
- bridge_letter_draft.pdf (draft bridge letter covering the audit window gap)
- redaction_readme.txt (explanation of redaction methodology and fields removed)

Secure download link (expires 2026-07-20): https://redwood-secure-downloads.s3.amazonaws.com/healthnet/2026-07/package-8463.zip?exp=2026-07-20
Retrieval token (HMAC): HMAC-xxxx-8463

If you need anything in native format or additional log slices, we can run a follow-up extract but that will require a one-week lead time for engineering/export redaction review. If procurement needs a signed NDA or DocuSign envelope, Monica can coordinate.

Please confirm receipt and whether the package satisfies your auditors’ immediate asks.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Emily Zhou <e.zhou@healthnet.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <m.lee@healthnet.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report + additional control evidence request

Rishi/Laura — received the package and downloading now. Initial quick check looks good; the redaction_readme was helpful. A couple follow-ups from our auditor: 

- Please confirm whether the MFA enforcement snapshot includes API keys and service principals (we need assurance that programmatic access is covered or a compensating control description).
- Our audit lead would like a signed bridge letter covering 2026-06-01 through 2026-07-15. The draft you provided looks fine; can Laura confirm she can sign/attest and provide a finalized, signed PDF?

Marcus — procurement will follow up on the secure share and confirm whether the team needs a formal NDA.

Thanks,
Emily
